title: Instrument player in browser
author: Active_Cauliflower71
selftext:
Hi I wanted to make an interesting midi visualizer / player for the instrument plugins im building. But this visualization is a robot band that plays the songs. You can also take over and play the instruments as well.

Here is the link to the project if you want to play with it.

[https://live.mobicat.club/](https://live.mobicat.club/)

I used mainly opus 5.5 to make the instrument sounds which I think is the most interesting part of the project. The guitars and saxophone are largely modeled from first principles and simulated so there are no actual sound clips that are being used. This makes it really great to be a tiny client that can be easily served over the web.

Fable 5.2 took care of the visualization of models and animations of the robot and environment. I think it does a lot better than opus on these.

some cool things i like about this project:

1. simulated instruments from physics and they sound pretty good
2. works in browser
3. You can have a multiplayer jam session with friends and play the instruments with a midi device or mouse and keyboard

Let me know if you find this interesting or have any feedback. Maybe this will inspire someone
